*   Determine which model provides more accurate depth based on the reprojection error [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the method involves estimating depth from augmented models and gauging the reliability of these depths by reprojecting pixels onto a different nearest training view and comparing them with the corresponding images. It further states that depth supervision is applied only if the reprojection error is low (i.e., the estimates are accurate). This process effectively determines which model (the main or the augmented, depending on reliability) provides more accurate depth for the purpose of supervision, aligning with the claim.

The claim incorrectly identifies $c$ as the true color.
